Message:
libbpf: Rename RELO_EXTERN to RELO_EXTERN_VAR

This patch renames RELO_EXTERN to RELO_EXTERN_VAR.
It is to avoid the confusion with a later patch adding
RELO_EXTERN_FUNC.
